items.stem: A field is sometimes absent from the source document. How should the schema and prompt handle it?

options.text: Mark it optional/nullable and instruct the model to return null when absent
options.rationale: Correct: an explicit null contract prevents invented values and stays schema-valid.

options.text: Require the field and let the model guess a value
options.rationale: Requiring a guess invites fabricated data.

options.text: Omit the field from the schema entirely
options.rationale: Omitting it loses the ability to represent the real, sometimes-present value.

options.text: Ask the model to leave the JSON malformed when unsure

items.explanation: Correct: an explicit null contract prevents invented values and stays schema-valid.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO measures most reduce fabricated values in extraction? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Instruct the model to return null for anything not present in the source
options.rationale: Correct: an explicit null-on-absence rule discourages invention.

options.text: Provide few-shot examples that include absent fields returned as null
options.rationale: Correct: examples teach the desired behaviour for missing data.

options.text: Tell the model to always produce a value for every field
options.rationale: Forcing a value for every field causes fabrication.

options.text: Raise the temperature to improve creativity
options.rationale: Higher temperature increases the chance of invented values.

items.explanation: Correct: an explicit null-on-absence rule discourages invention.

items.stem: Model output passes JSON-schema validation. What can you conclude?

options.text: That it is well-formed and typed correctly, but not that the extracted values are factually correct
options.rationale: Correct: schema validity is structural, not a guarantee of factual accuracy.

options.text: That the extraction is definitely accurate
That no evaluation against labelled data is needed
options.rationale: Accuracy still requires evaluation against labels.

options.text: That the source document was read in full
options.rationale: Schema validity does not prove full or faithful reading.

items.explanation: Correct: schema validity is structural, not a guarantee of factual accuracy.
